action.apply_hint: Carries out the recommended action now: opens the task, or snoozes or archives the inbox item. There is no further confirmation.

agents.title: AI agents
agents.subtitle: Create agents that work on tasks, choose when each one runs, and pause any of them instantly.
agents.empty: No AI agents yet. Create an AI provider and set a default model first.
agents.empty_ready: No AI agents yet. Agents are optional; create one to run a prompt on tasks you assign to it.
agents.empty_member: No AI agents yet. Agents need an AI provider, which a workspace admin connects.

scheduleKind.help: When this agent runs: never, on the server's recurring schedule, when a listed event happens, or only when you press Run now.
scheduleKind.label: Trigger

descriptions.disabled: Does not run on its own. Run now still works.
descriptions.interval: Runs on the server's recurring schedule.
descriptions.on_event: Runs when one of the listed events happens.
descriptions.manual: Runs only when you press Run now.

errors.pauseFailed: Could not pause or resume the agent

trigger.help: Queues one run right now. Disabled while the agent is paused.
trigger.label: Run now

eventTriggers.label: Event kinds
eventTriggers.help: Exact event names separated by commas, such as task.updated, signal.attached. The agent runs when one of them occurs.

create.title: New agent
create.name: Name
create.missingFields: Fill in name, model and system prompt
create.noModels: No models registered. Add an AI provider and model first.
create.noModels_member: No models are available. Ask a workspace admin to connect an AI provider.
create.systemPrompt_help: Standing instructions the agent follows on every run, such as its role and the rules it must respect. It cannot be edited on this page after creation.
create.model_help: The model this agent runs on. The list comes from the AI providers added to this workspace.

agents.pause_help: Pause stops this agent from running on any trigger, including Run now. Resume turns it back on.

triage.legacy_notice: This suggestion predates source tracking. Run triage again before applying it.
triage.source_changed: The source changed. Run triage again and review the updated suggestion.
triage.already_resolved: This suggestion was already resolved. Refresh the suggestions before continuing.
triage.opened: Task opened. The suggestion remains pending until you choose an action.
triage.success: {count, plural, one {# AI suggestion ready} other {# AI suggestions ready}}
triage.hint: AI reviews up to 20 items in one workspace (the one selected in the filter, or your first workspace when All workspaces is selected) and suggests Open, Snooze or Archive. Nothing changes until you press Apply.
triage.score_hint: The AI's score for this item, from 0 to 1. Higher means it likely needs attention sooner.

edit.title: Edit suggestion
edit.hint: Change the recommended action or the reasoning, then save. Applying the suggestion later uses what you saved here.

errors.identity_changed: Your account or workspace changed. Reopen the suggestion before trying again.

reminders.title: Overdue & due soon
reminders.page_subtitle: Open tasks due within three days or already overdue, based on their due dates.
reminders.empty: No reminders right now. Tasks with a due date appear here within three days of it, or when overdue.

days.future: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}

auto_actions.title: Suggested actions
auto_actions.hint: Actions the workspace's auto-action rules think are worth taking. Click one to open its task and decide.
